name: Exceptional Aid [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You’re always ready to lend your partner a hand.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mind.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the aid another action to assist an ally whom you can affect with your Bonded Mind feat on a skill check, the bonus is +4 instead of +2.
